metaDescription: Order custom full color badge reels with vibrant dye-sublimated designs. Perfect for branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color badge reels let you reproduce logos, photos, or gradients with photographic clarity using dye-sublimation. Unlike screen printing, full color process prints every shade without extra setup costs, making it ideal for complex artwork or multi-color brand marks. Whether you need 3/4" polyester lanyard reels for a trade show or heavy-weight satin options for daily office wear, the full color finish ensures your branding stays sharp and fade-resistant. Pair them with matching lanyards from our sublimated collection for a cohesive look.
heroAltText: Custom full color badge reels with dye-sublimated logo on a polyester lanyard and metal split-ring attachment.
